definitions.explanation: To arrive at or affect a certain range.
To total a certain number or extent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{及|およ}んだ。
⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{及|およ}んでいる。
examples.english: The influence extends throughout the world.
There's no need. / It's beyond me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数億|すうおく}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{及|およ}ぶ。
examples.english: The total damage amounts to several hundred million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千人|せんにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{及|およ}んだ。
examples.english: The participants numbered up to a thousand.

notes:
{及|およ}ぶ is an intransitive godan verb meaning to reach, extend to, or amount to.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive): {及|およ}ぶ - reaches/extends
- {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive): {及|およ}ぼす - to exert (influence)

PATTERN:
Xに{及|およ}ぶ: to reach/extend to X.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {及|およ}びません: no need / I can't compare (humble)
- {及|およ}ばない: not necessary, unnecessary
- {被害|ひがい}が{及|およ}ぶ: damage extends to

RELATED WORDS:
- {及|およ}び: and, as well as (formal conjunction)
- {及|およ}ぼす: to exert, to have (effect on)
- {言|い}{及|およ}ぶ: to mention, to refer to
